cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Another customer complaint about me! I'm becoming the focus of this hotel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Wonderful. Now management is organizing its day around me too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My own correspondence operation, reaching into laundry. I'll need more paper.

mechanism: A treats discipline as a request A can approve and celebrates each restriction as management effort and territorial expansion around A.
confusable: D65 calls losses voluntary concessions; D68 celebrates them as evidence of increasing influence, even if imposed.
comparison: A hotel complaint investigation differs from extra departmental workload and desk displacement.
seedUse: Use D68-b reception removal and laundry office assignment, making A grant and direct the imposed plan.
